description: GTFS - Programme des rotations Corsica Ferries is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Corsica Ferries. Programme des rotations 2025 des navires Corsica ferries depuis le continent français et italien vers la Corse, Sardaigne, Baleares, Elbe. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are GTFS, corsica ferries, ferries, mobilité, transport maritime, liaisons maritimes. The portal shows 60 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
